name: filt_portal_relay
description: 5x5 hollow FILT frame relaying a photon beam through a portal pair (PRTO in / GLOW / PRTI out rows).
why: Build-lessons 'laser bay': a FILT frame holds a PRTO/GLOW/PRTI sandwich that takes photons through a colour filter and teleports them on a channel -- decorate the FILT to set the transmitted colour (decorating FILT sets the photon colour it passes, per the rendering lesson). blueprint_lint flags PRTO as unjacketed (heat_source_uninsulated); accepted by design -- PRTO is deliberately embedded flush against the FILT ring on 3 sides and GLOW on the 4th exactly as captured, because the FILT frame's colour-filtering function requires the photon beam to pass directly through/beside it; inserting an INSL layer here would isolate PRTO from the frame it is meant to filter through and break the relay's actual purpose.
source: save2, exact pixel pattern x434-438 y91-95
